CLAUDE.md — dicomtk Development Guide

Source: CLAUDE.md

Project Overview

dicomtk is a comprehensive, CRAN-ready R package wrapping the OFFIS DICOM Toolkit (DCMTK 3.7.1) via native Rcpp bindings, designed with: 1. Self-contained C++ bundling: Bundles trimmed DCMTK source inside src/dcmtk/ compiled during R CMD INSTALL (with fallback/hybrid support for system DCMTK or CMake builds) and built-in DICOM dictionary (DCM_DICT_DEFAULT_USE_BUILTIN). 2. Tidyverse compliance: Returns tibble objects (tbl_df), uses snake_case function names, supports pipe-friendly (|>) workflows, and integrates with dplyr/tidyr. 3. Comprehensive DCMTK coverage: - Core (dcmdata): Header parsing (read_dicom(), read_dicom_header(), dicom_tags()), tag modification (dicom_modify()), de-identification/anonymization (dicom_anonymize()), XML/JSON/PDF conversion (dcm2xml(), dcm2json(), dcm2pdf()). - Image Processing & Codecs (dcmimgle, dcmimage, dcmjpeg, dcmjpls): Pixel extraction (read_dicom_pixels(), read_dicom_series()), VOI LUT & window/level presets (dicom_window()), RLE/JPEG/JPEG-LS compression and decompression (dicom_compress(), dicom_decompress()), PNG/NIfTI export (dicom_to_png(), dicom_to_nifti()). - Visualization: Static ggplot2 plotting (plot_dicom(), ggdicom()), interactive Shiny multi-slice viewer (dicom_viewer()), and 3D volume rendering via rgl (render_volume()). - Networking (dcmnet, dcmqrdb, dcmwlm): PACS connectivity (dicom_connect(), dicom_echo(), dicom_find(), dicom_get(), dicom_send(), dicom_receive()). - Structured Reporting & Advanced IODs (dcmsr, dcmrt, dcmseg, dcmpmap, dcmtract, dcmect, dcmpstat, dcmsign, dcmtls): Reading and creating DICOM SR, RT Structure Sets/Dose/Plan, Segmentations, Parametric Maps, and Tractography. 4. LLM Integration: Unified AI assistant interface (dicom_llm(), dicom_summarize(), dicom_describe_image(), dicom_report(), dicom_ask(), dicom_tag_lookup()) supporting local Ollama models and OpenAI-compatible APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure, local vLLM/LM Studio) with HIPAA-aware automatic de-identification before cloud transmission.

Coding Standards & Conventions

  1. Tidyverse Style:
    • All exported functions use snake_case.
    • Tabular return values must be tibble::tibble().
    • Functions operating on DICOM objects or file paths should take the primary data/path as the first argument so they compose naturally with |>.
    • Use cli::cli_abort(), cli::cli_warn(), and cli::cli_inform() (or rlang::abort()) for informative error messages.
  2. C++ / Rcpp Guidelines:
    • Never call std::exit(), abort(), or write directly to std::cout/std::cerr in C++ code (CRAN policy). Route all errors through Rcpp::stop() and warnings through Rcpp::warning().
    • Always check OFCondition::bad() after DCMTK calls and report cond.text().
    • Wrap heap-allocated DCMTK objects (DicomImage, DcmFileFormat, etc.) in std::unique_ptr so Rcpp::checkUserInterrupt() or exceptions never leak memory.
    • Always register codecs (DJDecoderRegistration, DJEncoderRegistration, DJLSDecoderRegistration, DJLSEncoderRegistration, DcmRLEDecoderRegistration, DcmRLEEncoderRegistration) at package load time and clean them up on unload.
  3. LLM Privacy & Safety:
    • When sending DICOM metadata or images to non-local LLM providers (provider != "ollama" and non-localhost URLs), automatically strip PHI/HIPAA tags by default (anonymize = TRUE) and warn the user if anonymize = FALSE.
  4. Backward Compatibility:
    • Preserve legacy functions from muschellij2/dcmtk (dcmdump(), dcmhd(), wide_hdr(), burned_annot(), dcm_anon(), dcm_subtract_date(), dcmj2pnm(), dcmdjpeg(), dcmdrle(), dcmcrle(), dcmodify()) in R/legacy.R, implemented on top of the fast native Rcpp engine.

Common Commands

# Generate RcppExports and roxygen documentation
Rscript -e "Rcpp::compileAttributes(); roxygen2::roxygenise()"

# Bundle/sync trimmed DCMTK sources from upstream clone
Rscript tools/bundle_dcmtk.R

# Build and install package locally
R CMD build .
R CMD INSTALL dicomtk_0.1.0.tar.gz

# Run test suite
Rscript -e "testthat::test_local()"

# Run CRAN check
R CMD check dicomtk_0.1.0.tar.gz --as-cran
